scope: Two short excerpts from US FTC consumer guidance. This is not a comprehensive knowledge base or caller-identity verification service.

documents.title: Avoiding and Reporting Gift Card Scams
documents.text: No real business or government agency will ever tell you to buy a gift card to pay them.

documents.title: Phone Scams
documents.section: You don't need to decide now
documents.text: Most honest businesses will give you time to think their offer over and get written information about it before you commit.
